profile.name: Sunpower CryoTel GT 低温制冷机
profile.description: CryoTel GT 是 Sunpower 的一款实验室用闭循环低温制冷机（冷头 + 控制器一体系统）。用于将样品或实验部件冷却到低温并维持设定温度，支持以功率或温度为控制目标的工作模式。设备带有温度设定点、功率设定与限制、恒温器输出、“到达温度”指示（绿色 LED 与 I/O 引脚）以及串行通信与数字 I/O 接口，适用于需要稳定低温环境的实验室应用。
profile.description_en: The CryoTel GT is a Sunpower laboratory closed-cycle cryocooler (cold head plus controller). It cools samples or components to cryogenic temperatures and maintains setpoints, supporting control by power or by temperature. The unit provides temperature setpoint, power setpoint and limits, a thermostat output, an "At Temperature" indicator (green LED and I/O pin), and serial/DIO interfaces for integration into lab setups.
